question: What paradoxical qualities characterize all these entities in their essential state?
premises: All of them are described as motionless.
All of them are described as without senses.
The statement is addressed to the trembling-eyed one.
inference: In their essential state, all these entities are motionless and without senses.
plain_english: O trembling-eyed one, all of them are motionless and without senses.
